headline: Sensex surges 1,502 points and Nifty reclaims 25,800 driven by FII inflows and reverse AI trade

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows spurred heavy buying across Indian equities.
India emerged as an anti-AI trade destination as investors shifted away from sliding US and Asian tech stocks.
Lower crude oil prices helped boost overall domestic investor confidence.
Significant gains in FMCG, private banking, and IT stocks propelled the main benchmark indices higher.
whatHappening: Sensex rallied 1,502 points while Nifty 50 ended above the 25,800 mark.
The Indian Rupee climbed 56 paise to hit an eight-month high of 92.29 against the US dollar.
The Union Cabinet approved projects worth nearly Rs 20,000 crore, including an Rs 11,000-crore bet on heavy machinery.
PhonePe is preparing to restart its IPO process amid favorable stock market conditions.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices surged heavily today, with the Sensex jumping 1,502 points and Nifty 50 reclaiming the 25,800 level.
The sharp market rally was powered by robust FII inflows, lower crude oil prices, and strong buying in FMCG and banking stocks.
Additionally, the Rupee strengthened to an eight-month high against the US dollar, while Bikaji Foods announced its foray into the bakery segment.
